source_dist_relationship.source_to_dist: Fresh builds were completed in this repair task before focused and full affected-package tests; tests imported the resulting dist artifacts.
source_dist_relationship.canonical_validation: Normal success and identity-conflict tests use the default real validatorFor('fastwork:domain:inbound-envelope'). Injected validators are used only for unavailable, false, and throwing failure branches.

tests.command: pnpm --filter @fastwork/domain build; pnpm --filter @fastwork/platform-pdd build; pnpm --filter @fastwork/desktop build

zero_side_effect_evidence.measurement_boundary: AI and legacy bridge are dynamically counted by the orchestrator/onInboundMessage callbacks. Transport send is dynamically counted only when a fixture adapter sendText is invoked. Persistence writes are not dynamically counted because the selected service has no persistence port or write dependency; zero is established by code-boundary inspection plus absence of persistence calls in the selected path. Success, identity-conflict, validator, collector, and async-return failures all stop before legacy bridge or downstream side effects.

mock_boundaries.fake_view: FakeView supplies WebContents identity and liveness only.
mock_boundaries.real_components: PddPlatformService, PddSessionHost, raw PDD normalization, identity/scope validation, canonical mapper, and default schema validator run as actual implementation.
mock_boundaries.not_claimed: No Electron IPC, real PDD, Titan, WebSocket, AI Worker, database, or production bootstrap integration is claimed.

remaining_real_producer_gap.description: The bounded unit still uses controlled Main-local raw PDD payload fixtures. A future real PDD/Titan/WebSocket producer requires separate integration review and must connect through the same trusted Main ingress rather than the legacy DOM message_received -> AI bridge.

known_limitations: Source time accepts a strict ISO-8601 UTC Z subset; offsets and unverified platform time semantics are treated as invalid/unknown.
No production IPC channel is registered for the new ingress.
No durable dedupe or persistence is implemented.
No real PDD or Electron IPC integration is claimed.
The legacy DOM dedup and AI bridge remain outside this bounded path and are not repaired here.
